admin.other_area: {name} is in another area ({area}), and a teleport only works within one.
admin.not_enough_gold: {name} does not carry that much gold.
admin.gold_range: Give an amount from 1 to {max}, or a negative one to take gold.
admin.cmd.heal: /aheal [number] - heal to full, yourself without a number
admin.cmd.health: /ahp <number> <health> - set a character's health, from 1 to its most
admin.cmd.bring: /abring <number> - bring a player to you (same area)
admin.cmd.gold: /agold <number> <amount> - give gold, a negative amount takes it
admin.revived: Asked {name}'s game to bring the character back.
admin.no_place: No place is called {text}. The panel's World tab lists them.
admin.no_teleport_yet: {name} has not been teleported since joining.
admin.item_too_few: {name} does not carry that many of {item}.
admin.cmd.panel: /admin [number] - the staff's panel, with a player's card for a number
admin.cmd.revive: /arevive <number> - bring a dead character back to life
admin.cmd.position: /apos [number] - where a character stands, yourself without a number
admin.cmd.teleport: /atp <place|x y z> - go to a place of the outside world, or to coordinates of your area
admin.cmd.back: /aback [number] - back to where a character stood before its last teleport
admin.cmd.item: /aitem give|take <number> <item> [count] - an item by its name or editor id
admin.cmd.time: /atime <hour> - the time of day in your area
